A colossal crimson fire dragon, armored scales glowing molten at the seams, twin sweeping black horns, vast ribbed wings flared wide, throat blazing white-hot as it gathers a torrent of flame, long spiked tail lashing.
An obsidian-black war-dragon scarred across the flank, blood-red wing-membranes spread, a crown of broken horns, exhaling a roaring jet of blue-white fire, smoke pouring from its fanged maw.

A storm-grey dragon crackling with arcs of lightning along its spines, pale wings beating hard, horns like splintered iron, its open jaws crackling with gathering electric breath, four taloned legs braced for impact.

A frost-white dragon exhaling a blizzard of killing ice, its massive ribbed wings coated in frozen rime, recurved ivory horns glazed with hoarfrost, thick scaled body trailing vapor, tail sweeping frozen ground to powder.

A molten volcanic dragon dripping rivers of orange lava between its scales, charcoal-black hide cracked like cooling magma, blunt obsidian horns, enormous heat-blurred wings spread wide, belching a geyser of superheated rock-spray.

A poison-green dragon spewing a roaring torrent of corrosive acid, translucent emerald wing-membranes veined black, long recurved horns slick with venom, its ridged belly scarred by old battles, four clawed feet gouging stone.

A bone-white undead dragon breathing streams of necrotic green fire, hollow eye-sockets glowing corpse-light, shattered horn stubs crowned with dark iron, tattered wing-membranes still impossibly bearing it aloft, scaled body stripped to grave-pale horror.

A bronze war-dragon scarred from a hundred battles, dull hammered-metal scales dented and gouged, thick swept horns notched by blades, vast leathery wings spread, breathing a cone of superheated steam and scalding metal-hot vapor.

A colossal red wyrm-tyrant, mountain-sized scales like overlapping shields of dark crimson, a forest of recurved horns ringing its skull, wings blotting the sky, roaring a cataclysmic pillar of white-orange flame downward.

A deep-sapphire dragon armored in cobalt scales, twin elegant spiral horns crackling with blue static, wide indigo wing-membranes shot through with silver veins, discharging a sustained bolt of pure chain lightning from its gaping jaws.

A gold-scaled solar dragon blazing with reflected sunfire, sweeping ram-horns gilded bright, massive sun-yellow wings fully outstretched, a scar bisecting its left eye, exhaling a searing beam of concentrated radiant light that chars stone black.

A swamp-brown dragon reeking of rot, scales encrusted with moss and river mud, curved amber horns, ragged torn wings still powerful enough to beat, releasing a billowing cloud of flesh-melting toxic miasma from its gullet.

A silver-scaled arctic dragon, scales like polished mirror-ice, twin tapered horns white as glacier bone, enormous silver-veined wings beating frozen gales, a deep battle-wound raking its shoulder, exhaling a cone of absolute-zero crystallizing freeze-breath.

A shadow-black dragon almost invisible against a night sky, only its burning violet eyes visible, membrane wings silent as death, serrated curved horns, breathing a stream of howling shadow-void that extinguishes light and life alike.

A deep-purple amethyst dragon crusted with gem-like scale clusters, tri-pronged horns glinting dark violet, immense dark wings spread, throat pulsing with arcane energy, unleashing a spiraling beam of raw destructive magical force in a blinding burst.

A rust-red iron dragon with scales like hammered plate-armor, blunt squared horns, battle-scarred hide pocked with ancient spear-wounds, vast rust-orange wings beating dust storms, breathing a crushing pressurized torrent of superheated metallic steam.

A deep-sea teal dragon surging upward from ocean spray, barnacled scales edged in brine-green, swept-back trident horns, enormous dripping wings fully fanned, exhaling a high-pressure blast of freezing saltwater and crushing hydro-force.

A chalk-white plague dragon exhaling roiling clouds of diseased yellow miasma, cracked alabaster scales weeping ichor, splintered yellowed horns, ragged but vast wings pumping fetid air, tail riddled with old lance-wounds, eyes burning fever-gold.

A deep-crimson chaos dragon with asymmetrical scales, one horn sheared off in ancient battle, its mismatched scarred wings straining wide, belching a twisting multicolored balefire that warps reality at the edges, tail spiked with bone protrusions.

An emerald forest dragon with vine-etched scales, long elegant swept-back horns, broad leaf-veined wings of deep green, a spear-scar through its left wing-membrane, breathing a concentrated torrent of razor-sharp thorned wind and toxic pollen-cloud.

A charcoal-grey ash dragon trailing soot from every scale-seam, twin blunt horns coated gray, enormous ashen wings shedding cinders, a slash-wound crossing its jaw, exhaling a roiling eruption of scorching ash-cloud and burning ember-storm.

A deep-indigo void dragon with scales that seem to swallow light, long spiraling night-black horns, vast dark wing-membranes patterned with faint stars, exhaling a silent beam of entropic annihilation that unravels matter into drifting black dust.

A copper-scaled desert dragon, sun-baked hide cracked like parched earth, wide curved horns burnished orange, broad sandy-membrane wings kicking up cyclones, a deep claw-gouge along its neck, breathing a blasting hurricane of superheated razor-edged sand.

A blood-orange magma dragon with scales glowing at every edge, curved volcanic glass horns, vast fire-veined wings spread against a smoky sky, old sword-gashes across its chest scaled over like cooled lava, vomiting liquid fire.

A midnight-blue venom dragon with iridescent scale-sheen, long back-swept twin horns dripping black ichor, enormous dark-veined wings fully extended, a ragged scar from horn to shoulder, unleashing a pressurized stream of paralytic neuro-toxin venom spray.
